_comment: ADR-037 register fragment - the-decision-as-a-walked-process tasks 8.1 and 8.2 (REQ-DWP-008). A decision type may declare `riskScore`, a declarative expression over the decision's own properties: rules that each add points when a property matches, and bands that name the total. DecisionRiskScoreListener evaluates it on every save of a decision (so a send, which writes the decision, scores it, and a change to a property the expression reads scores it again) and writes `riskAssessment`: the score, the band and the properties that produced it. No model and no service call. Properties only, so no schema version moves, as in 140-a-step-may-take-a-nominated-approver.

riskScore.title: Risk score
riskScore.description: How a decision of this type is scored before approval. Each rule adds its points when the decision's property matches; the band is the highest one whose minimum the total reaches. When empty, decisions of this type carry no score.

property.title: Property
property.description: The decision's property the rule reads; a dotted path reads into an object.

operator.title: Operator
operator.description: How the property is compared with the value.

value.title: Value
value.description: What the property is compared with. `gt`, `gte`, `lt` and `lte` compare as numbers; `eq` and `neq` compare as text. Not read by `in`, `notIn` or `present`.

values.title: Values
values.description: The list `in` and `notIn` compare the property with, as text.

points.title: Points
points.description: What the rule adds to the score when it matches.

min.title: From score
min.description: The lowest score in this band.

riskAssessment.title: Risk assessment
riskAssessment.description: Written by the server from the type's `riskScore` on every save; empty when the type declares none. `basis` lists the properties that produced the score, each with the value read and the points it added, so the approver sees why (REQ-DWP-008).

value.description: The value the rule read, as text.
